Description: Rising matcha demand in London across cafés and retail. Translating into latte kits, powders, syrups, and dessert applications.
Londoners’ appetite for pistachio and kunefe treats continues to grow. Opportunity in spreads, fillings, bakery SKUs, and premium desserts.
Ube is gaining traction as the next big flavour. Strong visual and social pull for drinks, desserts, and bakery innovation.
Driven by high-protein demand and social media. Opportunity in protein dairy, snack pots, dessert hacks, and better-for-you formats.
Hot honey is in the mainstream. Broad opportunity in drizzles, glazes, sachets, and sweet-spicy toppings for multiple eating occasions.
